confirmed.title: Nested subfolders create phantom quarantine rows keyed by basename, with PK collisions
confirmed.claim: scan() registers every depth!=4 quarantine as a ledger session with `sid = Path(path).name`. Because session_id is the primary key and the insert is guarded by `ledger.get(sid) is None`, all later same-named subdirs under *different* sessions silently collapse onto the first row — they appear in the per-run print but never in the ledger or the folder-issues report, whose bad_path identity/detail then points at the wrong drive_path.
